Seagrove Beach

3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths

Steps to the community pool (seasonally heated)!

Six-seater golf cart!

Explore Seaside

Patio with firepit and propane grill!

Skee-ball machine

5-star restaurants

Fun eateries and boutiques

Saltwater Song by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Saltwater Song is a beautifully updated townhome that makes beach life easy and fun. In the heart of Seagrove Beach, it’s spacious, stylish, and perfect for your next getaway. In a great location, with plenty of room to relax indoors and out, your gang will love the convenience of a short walk to the beach and a coastal dune lake. Getting around is a breeze with a complimentary 6-seater, street-legal golf cart, making beach trips and exploring 30A a breeze. Popular spots like Coastal Dune Co, Old Florida Fish House, and 30A Trading Co are just minutes away. A quick stroll to Eastern Lake Beach Access puts soft, white sands and a rare coastal dune lake within reach. On lucky days, watch the lake flow (outfall) into the Gulf, offering a unique chance to splash in both the lake and the gulf!

A playful zone for swimmers and paddleboarders alike. After a day of sun and sand, the outdoor spaces at Saltwater Song shine. Sip drinks on the spacious balcony, share stories around the fire pit on the patio, or turn marshmallow roasting into a nightly tradition. The inside is just as inviting. The second-floor primary suite offers a king bed and a quiet retreat, while the first-floor guest room, bunkroom, and cozy hallway bunks provide plenty of space for the whole crew. Everyone gets their own corner to recharge. With its fresh updates and modern vibe, Saltwater Song is more than a beach house—it’s the perfect backdrop for making unforgettable 30A memories. Overview: - Complimentary 6-seater golf cart - 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths - Sleeps 8 (including hallway bunks) - Garage for golf cart + parking for 2 cars - Wi-Fi + flat-screen TVs in living areas and bedrooms - Washer/Dryer - Access to the seasonally heated community pool - Patio with fire pit off of guest room and bunkroom Overnight: 1ST FLOOR - Guest Room: Queen bed, access to back porch - Bunkroom: Twin-over-full bunk, access to back porch - Twin-over-twin hallway bunks 2ND FLOOR - Primary Suite: King bed, en-suite bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST.
